brand.notes: Single 12 x 18 in broadside. The wordmark appears twice through the \ac macro, in the byline and the colophon; both inspected at 900 dpi with the pink period. Every other mention is the lowercase host aesthetic.computer or the mono kicker AESTHETIC.COMPUTER.

diagrams.notes: Nine rock cards, 08:03 to 12:37 on neo. Each card: a 1.22 in rock trimmed to its bounds on the left, mono host:name with an agent pill, a time-and-turns line with a status pill, then a three-to-five line sans paragraph. Rules between cards, equal card widths, no clipping; the column header carries its range right-aligned.
Nine rock cards, 12:37 to 16:14 on neo, same grammar as the morning column; column bottom lands level with its neighbours within one rule of spacing. Pills read at size; no wraps break a name.

Nine rock cards: six neo evening rocks then blueberry:zevo, blueberry:piro and panda:iris. Header shortened so it no longer wraps; the other-machine names run longer in mono but stay on one line beside their pills.
